listenings.text: Yes, yes, everything is clear. Thank you. I think I have it all. If there is a problem, maybe I will call you later. Okay, thank you, bye.

Almost. Sorry, I didn't catch the date. The fifteenth? And the amount is three thousand two hundred, is that right? Paula approves it, doesn't she? Let me note that down. So, to summarize: three thousand two hundred, on the fifteenth, and Paula approves.
